description.value: Quiznos is a toasted sub sandwich chain with Canadian roots, offering hot made-to-order subs with a range of proteins and toppings. This Chilliwack franchise location (unit 368) serves the full national menu including classic Italian, chicken, meatball, and vegetarian options. For touring cyclists, it offers a quick hot meal with takeout service.
